# Third-party notices for Pyre Pensieve

Pyre Pensieve is under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. It's built on the open-source work below, each under its own license. Where a library offers a choice of licenses, the one used here is named.

## Built with

### Rust standard library 1.99.1

License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (used here: MIT, with the notices below for the files and libraries inside it). https://www.rust-lang.org

Built into every copy of the app.

### Ubuntu libraries in the AppImage 22.04

License: LGPL-2.1-or-later and others (used here: as each package states). https://packages.ubuntu.com/jammy/

Only in the Linux AppImage. It carries GTK 3, WebKitGTK and the other libraries they need, unchanged from Ubuntu 22.04, so it runs on more versions of Linux. Most are under the LGPL 2.1 or later; the rest are under their own open-source licenses. Each one's copyright and license file is inside the AppImage, in usr/share/doc. Their source is available from Ubuntu at https://packages.ubuntu.com/jammy/ and https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/jammy. The .deb and the Windows and Mac versions don't carry them.

This AppImage carries these 98 Ubuntu packages: libatk-bridge2.0-0, libatk1.0-0, libatomic1, libatspi2.0-0, libavahi-client3, libavahi-common3, libblkid1, libbrotli1, libbsd0, libcairo-gobject2, libcairo2, libcolord2, libcups2, libdatrie1, libdeflate0, libdw1, libelf1, libenchant-2-2, libepoxy0, libevdev2, libffi8, libgcrypt20, libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0, libglib2.0-0, libgnutls30, libgraphite2-3, libgssapi-krb5-2, libgstreamer-gl1.0-0, libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-0, libgstreamer1.0-0, libgtk-3-0, libgudev-1.0-0, libharfbuzz-icu0, libhogweed6, libhyphen0, libicu70, libidn2-0, libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-0, libjbig0, libjpeg-turbo8, libk5crypto3, libkrb5-3, libkrb5support0, liblcms2-2, liblz4-1, libmanette-0.2-0, libmd0, libmount1, libnettle8, libnghttp2-14, liborc-0.4-0, libp11-kit0, libpango-1.0-0, libpangocairo-1.0-0, libpangoft2-1.0-0, libpcre2-8-0, libpixman-1-0, libpng16-16, libproxy1v5, libpsl5, librsvg2-2, libseccomp2, libsecret-1-0, libsoup-3.0-0, libsqlite3-0, libsystemd0, libtasn1-6, libthai0, libtiff5, libudev1, libunistring2, libunwind8, libwayland-cursor0, libwayland-egl1, libwayland-server0, libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0, libwebp7, libwebpdemux2, libwebpmux3, libwoff1, libxau6, libxcb-randr0, libxcb-render0, libxcb-shm0, libxcomposite1, libxcursor1, libxdamage1, libxdmcp6, libxext6, libxfixes3, libxi6, libxinerama1, libxkbcommon0, libxml2, libxrandr2, libxrender1, libxslt1.1, libzstd1.
